population.dataset: GRID3 NGA Population v3.0 — gridded population estimates (Bayesian model, 100 m cells, UN-WPP 2025-scaled)
population.publisher: GRID3 (Geo-Referenced Infrastructure and Demographic Data for Development) / WorldPop, University of Southampton

settlements.dataset: GRID3 NGA Settlement Points (settlement names), released March 2021
settlements.publisher: eHealth Africa, Proxy Logics and Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL), GRID3

meta.method: Zonal sum, raster to point: people in 100 m cells whose centre lies within 5, 10, 25, 50 km (great-circle distance) of the site; sea cells are no-data = 0. Nearest settlement = nearest GRID3 named settlement point; its population = cells within 2 km of the point. Main centre = the named point within 25 km with the largest 2-km population. Modelled population (an estimate), not a census count.

fields.pop5km|pop10km|pop25km|pop50km: people within the radius (modelled, GRID3 v3.0)
fields.nearest_settlement|nearest_settlement_lg: nearest GRID3 named settlement; pop = people within 2 km of it; dist_km = site → point
fields.main_centre_25km|main_centre_25km_pop|ma: largest named settlement within 25 km by 2-km population
fields.state|state_basis: containing state, or nearest state for offshore sites (scripts/classify_niger_delta.py)
